notes: Typos fixed: none. The main area of the live Wix gallery page holds one piece of text, the heading Gallery. It is stored exactly as Wix writes it. Its capital G is typed, not styling (textTransform is none).
title and description are the live Wix title tag and meta description, unchanged. The first version had the same two texts.
The 21 slots are in the order of the live Wix gallery, checked against the reference screenshot of the live page.
On the live Wix page the second item (g02) is a video that shows a still frame with a play button. The first version replaced it with a still image and this file keeps that: 21 image slots, no video.

The live Wix gallery gives all 21 photos an empty alt text, so every alt_original is the description from the first version, copied exactly. Each one was compared with the reference screenshot and describes the photo in its position.
Only g12 and g13 are real photos and show their alt. The other 19 are placeholders, so their alt is empty until the owner saves a licensed photo over them.

foils-highlights (slot gallery-03) is also used on the live Home, About and Book Online pages. Wix gives it other alt texts there (only a file name on Home, a sentence about foil highlights on About). Neither describes the photo, which shows a stylist finishing a style with hairspray, so the first version description is kept here.
link_label is the accessible name of each photo link. {n} is the position of the photo (1 to 21) and {total} is the number of photos.
The photo viewer (lightbox) is built by js/site.js (contract section 8), so its button labels are not in this file.
